visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up of decorative gold and black balloons printed with the "Ultherapy" brand name. The background shows a modern, minimalist clinic interior with the "DRX Dermatology Clinic" logo on a glass partition. The lighting is bright and professional, creating a high-end medical atmosphere. (2) The camera focuses on the "Ultherapy PRIME" product packaging and informational brochures laid out on a clean white countertop. The labels are clearly visible. Next, several yellow cooling gel pads and a black fabric headband are shown, representing the preparation phase of the cosmetic treatment. (3) A shot reveals the Ultherapy PRIME medical device, a sleek white and gray console on a rolling cart. Text overlays appear on the left side of the screen listing performance metrics like "10X High Efficiency" and "Comfort Improvement." The device features a large monitor and attached treatment probes. (4) A healthcare professional, wearing black gloves, uses a white pencil to draw marking lines on a female patient's face for precise treatment targeting. The patient lies comfortably on a clinical bed. The scene is illuminated with bright, even indoor lighting typical of a medical facility. (5) The practitioner operates a handheld Ultherapy device against the patient's skin. A blue indicator light pulses on the handpiece during use. Subtitles emphasize the reduction in pain. The patient remains calm with a neutral expression throughout the non-invasive procedure. (6) Close-up of the medical monitor showing a real-time ultrasound scan of skin tissue and treatment progress icons. A finger points to the screen, highlighting the "DeepSEE" visualization technology. The interface is colorful and data-dense, indicating advanced technology. (7) A split-screen comparison shows "BEFORE" and "AFTER" results for a middle-aged woman from frontal and profile angles. Text at the bottom specifies the improved areas, such as the jawline and marionette lines. The lighting in both shots is consistent for accurate comparison. (8) The final screen transitions to a gray and white background with the DRX Dermatology Clinic branding. It displays the clinic's social media handle, phone number, and two physical addresses in Traditional Chinese. The text "Welcome to contact us" appears at the very bottom.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a commercial promotion for Ultherapy PRIME treatments at DRX Dermatology Clinic. It emphasizes the machine's technical upgrades—such as increased precision and reduced discomfort—while demonstrating a real procedure on a patient to build trust and showcasing effective results through before-and-after comparisons.
